mission.objective: Test truthful short-form creative angles for a verified HUNT product before any publishing or spend.

market_evidence.signal: Similar vintage/floral phone cases are actively listed in 2026 on TikTok Shop, including a comparable floral case at $13.16 with free shipping.
Current 2026 phone-case trend coverage continues to feature floral/botanical and vintage aesthetics.

audience.primary: Style-conscious phone-accessory shoppers who like vintage, floral, soft-art and cottagecore-inspired aesthetics.
secondary: gift shoppers seeking a small visual accessory
buyers bored with generic clear or plain cases
audience.avoid: Do not target based on insecurity, body image, or sensitive personal traits.

positioning.core: A small visual refresh for the phone: soft vintage-floral styling at an accessible product price.
positioning.proof_boundary: Use only verified product facts. Treat 'Korean' as a style label from the supplier title, not country-of-origin or manufacture.

hooks: From plain phone to vintage-floral in one snap.
When your phone looks more like a tiny art print than a gadget.
Soft florals. Retro mood. Everyday case.
POV: your phone finally matches the rest of your aesthetic.
Three seconds to give your phone a completely different look.
A little vintage wallpaper energy for your phone.
Tired of the same clear case? Try a floral reset.
Make the phone on your desk part of the decor.

Do not claim drop-tested, military-grade, shockproof, anti-yellowing, MagSafe, wireless charging, scratch-proof or premium unless independently verified.
Do not claim exclusive/original artwork merely because the supplier description uses 'original'.
Do not guarantee the 9-23 day shipping estimate.
Do not advertise $5.99 as the all-in checkout total; verified shipping is separate for IL.
Do not compare performance or quality to named competitors without evidence.

Any durability/performance claims beyond supplier text

prompts.name: Phone Outfit Change
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 product commercial. Start with a plain smartphone on a clean neutral desk in soft daylight. A hand passes briefly across the lens as a transition. Reveal the same phone wearing a soft-shell vintage floral case with delicate botanical artwork. Smooth macro camera move over the printed flowers, TPU edge and camera cutout. Finish with a tasteful flatlay beside a notebook and dried flowers. Natural motion, realistic materials, clean ecommerce lighting, no logos, no extra text rendered into the scene. Leave negative space for later captions.

prompts.name: Tiny Art Print
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 aesthetic product film. Extreme macro of a vintage floral phone-case pattern, shallow depth of field, warm natural window light. Slowly rotate the phone to show the printed floral artwork, soft-shell edge and camera opening. Transition to a styled desk scene with paper, lace texture and dried flowers, keeping the phone as the clear hero. Calm premium-looking cinematography without claiming premium materials. No people, no logos, no embedded text.

prompts.name: Plain to Floral
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 before-and-after product ad. Begin with a generic plain phone case on a minimal desk. Use a fast swipe transition to reveal the same phone in a vintage floral soft-shell case. Show three quick detail shots: floral print, flexible-looking TPU edge, camera cutout. End on a clean product hero shot with neutral background and empty lower-third space for a later compatibility and shipping disclaimer. Realistic ecommerce style, no logos, no claims rendered into video.
